retained_limitations: The exact acceptance date, issue publication date, and online-first chronology for the Journal of Automated Reasoning article were not independently reconstructed from publisher metadata in this review.
The author archive preserves proof artifacts, but repository-local exact-byte copies and hashes of every EQP, Otter, proof-object, and checker file were not created here.
The 1998 Dahn paper is identified bibliographically as a simplified presentation, but its complete text was not preserved in this repository review.
Later human-readable, Mizar, Mathematica, and other reformulations represent distinct verification and exposition events and must not be collapsed into the 1996 automated discovery date.
Candidate generation, successful machine search, proof-object checking, public disclosure, journal publication, simplification, and later formalization remain separate chronology fields.

coding_effect.independent_coder_may_use: Only through a versioned source-packet update that preserves chronology separation and retained limitations.
coding_effect.confidence_effect: The discovery date and primary author artifact chain are strongly supported; full archival byte preservation and complete publication chronology remain incomplete.

completion_boundary: SRC-003 is terminal as LIMITATION_RETAINED. This receipt establishes an evidence-backed chronology without claiming complete archival reconstruction, independent rerun of EQP, or confirmation of the TIDC hypothesis.
